The output is stuck low (`vout_max` ≈ `vout_min` ≈ 0), and `vinp` has no effect. In M1 (`a t t vss`), the gate is tied to the tail node `t` (same as its source) instead of `vinp`. With Vgs = 0, M1 stays off, so node `a` sits high, M4 turns off, `b` is pulled low by M2, M7 pulls `c` high, and M10 holds `vout` low regardless of the input. That matches every observed symptom. The fault is M1's gate, which should be `vinp`. M2 and M7 are the next candidates, since they sit on the same path to `c`.
